The authors identify a dominant 24 Da cross-link (cleaving to 12 Da fragments in MS2) and a 12 Da modification on linear peptides. While not a standard PTM modifier in the provided list, it fits the 'mod_complexome' or a general XL-MS routing. SCX was used for enrichment of cross-linked peptides.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study focuses on the chemical mechanism of formaldehyde (FA) cross-linking. The primary biological variable is the exposure to FA at various concentrations and durations. No specific inhibitor or activator class from the ontology was used; it is a general chemical treatment for cross-linking. Matched_class_key is null because FA is used as a cross-linking reagent, which does not fit the specific inhibitor/activator/degrader subclasses provided in the ontology.

Standard XL-MS pipelines may not support this specific symmetric cleavage/remnant pattern.
